Comment.value: Shifter initiation reward (roadmap: shifter-quest), given by q_shf_finish with 1000 XP when the Tuft of the First Skin is handed to Halmir. Mirrors the sibling prestige rewards' power tier (three +3-tier properties, no AB/damage -- forge-cap-safe), themed for the skin-changers: Animal Empathy +3 (skill subtype 0, SKILL_ANIMAL_EMPATHY), Search +3 (skill subtype 14, SKILL_SEARCH -- the tracker's nose), Saving Throw Bonus vs Mind-Affecting +3 (IP_CONST_SAVEVS_MINDAFFECTING = 11, verified in ovr/nwscript.nss -- keep your own name inside another skin; no vs-polymorph save constant exists). Deliberately avoids all sibling reward skills. An AMULET on purpose: neck-slot item properties ride through most polymorph/wild shapes under the engine's item-merge rules, so the reward stays live in the forms a Shifter actually fights in. ModelPart1 6 + palette copied from the module's existing Amulet of the Wild.

value.0: A claw of grey Carrock-stone on a plaited cord of horsehair and bear-gut, warm to the touch in any weather. The Beornings hang its like over their door-posts, and the skin-changers wear it against the skin -- whichever skin: a charm at the throat rides through most changes of shape when heavier gear will not. Halmir the Grey gave it over when the Tuft of the First Skin was laid in his hand -- the token of those the orders call Shifters, who wear another shape and keep their own name inside it.
